title: High School Students' "Magical Sketchbook" Drawings
content: By Dan, Millburn High SchoolKathleen Harte- Gilsenan, teacher at theMillburn High Schoolin New Jersey says: "My students are following your blog this year and last week their weekly sketchbook assignment was inspired by themagical sketchbook videoyou posted."By Audrey, Millburn High School"Each student watched the video and then choose a photo of their own and altered the reality of the photo by adding a sketch of something from observation."Thanks, Kathleen, and great job, Audrey, Dan, and the rest of the students.-----Previouspost on the magical sketchbook.
